crossRefs.note: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.
For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.
“Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Return, and turn…

translations.web: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”
translations.bsb: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.”
translations.kjv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
translations.asv: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
